newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank takes stake in Bulgarian firm.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank takes stake in Bulgarian firm.

text.p: Swiss cement and construction materials maker Holderbank Financiere Glarus AG said it had signed a preliminary contract for a 51-percent stake in Bulgaria's Beloizvorski Cement JS Co.
Holderbank said it would pay 32.5 million to acquire the share capital from the Bulgarian state.
"The remainder of the share capital will remain, for the time being, in the hands of the Bulgarian state," a Holderbank statement said.
It said the final agreement was expected to be signed by the end of May "once the concession rights for exploitation of the quarries have been definitively approved," Holderbank said.
Beloizvorski operates a dry process cement plant 120 km northeast of Sofia with an annual capacity of one million tonnes, Holderbank said.

The plant, which Holderbank said was one of the most modern facilities in Bulgaria, now delivers about half a million tonnes to the domestic market and another 0.4 million tonnes for export through the Black Sea port of Burgas.
